268047|c401ba80.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|c401ba80.text: $N, the Stormpike Guard is in need of your aid in the battle against the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac Valley, now more than ever.  The opportunities for honor and repute are greater than ever as well! Will you join the battle?

4165|1c7cd7a4.name: Elissa Dumas
4165|1c7cd7a4.text: I do not believe you possess the mental acuity to grasp the nature of portal magic.

2518-progress.name: Priestess A'moora
2518-progress.text:
I regret the task that I have asked you to carry out; but Lady Sathrah is beyond hope.

It is our hope to offer the sacrifice of the spinnerets to Elune. With this sacrifice, Elune will bless Sathrah so that she might be reborn, and at peace.
2518-progress.title: Tears of the Moon

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6662-progress.name: Nipsy
6662-progress.text:
<Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>

Alive and kicking... and just in time!
6662-progress.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

7807-progress.name: Bubulo Acerbus
7807-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Gnomeregan Exiles for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7807-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

923-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-progress.text: Have you been to Wellspring Lake, $N?  Have you been hunting the timberlings there?
923-progress.title: Tumors

935-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
935-progress.text:
I know that I did not summon you, so I cannot help but wonder why it is you have come to speak with me.

Whatever it is, please make it quick.
935-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

937-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-progress.text: Their slashing talons and piercing beaks may prove a difficult match for your own abilities, $N, but I have faith that you will not fail in this task.
937-progress.title: The Enchanted Glade

940-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
940-progress.text: Hmm... You come with the spirit of the forest strongly within you, $c. What business do you have with the Arch Druid of the Kaldorei?
940-progress.title: Teldrassil

94466-complete.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94466-complete.text:
These'll do fine, $N.

Fire ain't just fury and ruin--mark me words. It's life, it's forge, it's the breath o' creation. All things are bound in balance. One force tempers the other, gives it meaning. Without shadow, light's but a glare. Without flame, stone's but cold memory.

Masterin' magic means knowin' when to blend, not just burn. That's true wisdom, lad.
94466-complete.title: Call of Fire

94466-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94466-progress.text: Aye, I've near all I need for the fire sapta, $N--just missin' the fire tar and the seer's pouch. The tar's carried by Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north. The pouch ye'll need to wrest from a Stonesplinter seer in the southern hills. These ingredients are bound to flame, as all true saptas must be. Their elemental ties make our craft strong.
94466-progress.title: Call of Fire

94467-accept.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94467-accept.text:
The fire sapta's ready, $N. Now ye face the flame. Use it at the shrine, then climb to the peak. There, ye'll see the spirit--he'll not strike 'til ye do, but he'll know ye see him.

Strike fast, lad. The longer ye wait, the stronger he burns. When he falls, take his glowing embers and place 'em in the brazier. Light the torch and earn the fire's favor.
94467-accept.title: Call of Fire

94467-complete.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94467-complete.text:
A white hot flame ignites within the bowl as you place the ember within. You can feel the magical effects of the sapta coursing through your body and the fire dances rhythmically before you.

You place the top of the torch within the basin, and it immediately catches on fire. The smoke seems to drift towards the peak of the looming mountain.
94467-complete.title: Call of Fire

94467-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94467-progress.text:
The brazier stands about a third your height, with charred inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch. 

Blackrock Mountain looms in the distance, in clear view to honor from this sacred place.
94467-progress.title: Call of Fire

94468-accept.name: Unknown
94468-accept.text:
Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.

You start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.
94468-accept.title: Call of Fire

94468-progress.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94468-progress.text: Aye, $N? What do ye have there?
94468-progress.title: Call of Fire

94473-complete.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94473-complete.text:
May fire burn within your heart, $N.

The elements await you.
94473-complete.title: Fire Sapta

98065-progress.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
98065-progress.text: Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.
98065-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

98392-progress.text: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
98392-progress.title: Darkness in the Glade

99050-progress.name: Byancie
99050-progress.text: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.
99050-progress.title: The Great Tree Provides

99073-progress.title: Easing Suffering
